title: Adversarial fuzz confirmation: e3confirm-20260729-0001 (frontmatter)
subtitle: Post-PR-#163 (cd54074) confirmation run, corrected pre-fix baseline fa675cf
summary_html:
Confirmation campaign e3confirm-20260729-0001 re-ran four bounded adversarial workers against the frontmatter subsystem (388 total cases: boundary-probe 99, differential-probe 97, shape-probe 86, template-probe 106) on HEAD d2acdb1 (contains fix cd54074 / PR #163), using the corrected pre-fix baseline fa675cf (cd54074^). At the worker-execution level every worker completed cleanly: zero panics, hangs, timeouts, confinement bypasses, or nondeterminism.

Fuzz run descriptionIterationsPassResult
Malformed files, invalid var-file boundaries, path confinement, and stable diagnostics (frontmatter target)9999/99PASS
Baseline-vs-head parity, JSON/YAML equivalence, and deterministic output (frontmatter target, corrected baseline fa675cf)9797/97PASS
Recursive JSON/YAML frontmatter structures, duplicate-key handling, and BOM edge cases8686/86PASS
Jinja whitespace/newline normalization and output-formatting edge cases106106/106PASS

This is execution health, not a clean campaign outcome. The campaign confirmed 8 product bugs (FUZZ-001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006, 008, 009), 1 intentional boundary (FUZZ-007), and 2 inconclusive items (FUZZ-004 relates to a new gap shipped with cd54074; FUZZ-010 and FUZZ-011 need a product ruling, not a code fix). Zero regression tests were promoted by design: every confirmed bug is currently unfixed, so no passing durable test could be written without either failing CI or enshrining the defect as intended behavior.
recommendations_html:
• FUZZ-004 (highest priority — shipped with cd54074): thread line/column into ERR_VAL_MISSING_REQUIRED for the variables: declaration style so it matches required_variables. Owner: comp.
  • FUZZ-006: reject or losslessly preserve JSON integers beyond u64::MAX; never silently round to f64 while validate --json reports valid: true. Owner: comp.
  • FUZZ-008 (partial-fix gap in cd54074/PR #163, not a full regression): strip all leading BOMs (loop or trim_start_matches) instead of exactly one. Owner: comp.
  • FUZZ-009 (partial-fix gap in cd54074/PR #163, not a full regression): apply duplicate-key detection to frontmatter variables:/defaults: maps, matching the var-file boundary. Owner: comp.
  • FUZZ-001/002/003/005: diagnostic-code/exit-family consistency fixes (map ERR_CONFIG_READ to exit 3; give path-confinement refusals a dedicated code; return ERR_RESOLVE_NOT_FOUND for a directory passed as --file; propagate serde_yaml error location into --json diagnostics). Owner: comp.
  • FUZZ-010: product ruling needed on trailing CR/blank-line normalization (deliberate code, self-consistent round-trip, no documented intent). Owner: team-lead.
  • FUZZ-011: cosmetic duplicated diagnostic-code prefix in human-mode ValidationError output; registry disclaims human-message stability so no contract is violated. Owner: comp.
  • FUZZ-007 is an intentional consequence of fix (c) (both required_variables and variables: now feed one duplicate-detection set); document the cross-section duplicate rule in requirements.md.
footer_html: Durable source: /tmp/sc-fuzz-e3confirm-20260729-0001/campaign-report.json (schema adversarial-fuzzing/v1). No production code was modified and no regression tests were promoted or committed for this session, per the campaign's promotion_decision (all 8 confirmed bugs are currently unfixed).

findings.expected_oracle: Top-level boundary: raw frontmatter text and --- delimiters must never leak into rendered body output. This is precisely the BOM-frontmatter-leak class cd54074 targeted for the single-BOM case.
findings.observed_result: Exit 0. Rendered stdout is '\uFEFF---~required_variables:~  - name~---~Hello World' -- one BOM plus the entire raw frontmatter header leaks into the body. Root cause: parse_template_document calls strip_prefix('\u{feff}') exactly ONCE, so a second BOM defeats opening_delimiter_len and split_frontmatter returns None, treating the whole document as body. Single-BOM control renders correctly as 'Hello World'.
findings.requirement_trace: Not a regression -- the pre-fix baseline leaks too (with both BOMs). But it means the BOM-frontmatter-leak defect CLASS is only closed for exactly one leading BOM, not closed in general.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Strip all leading BOMs (loop or trim_start_matches) instead of exactly one, or fail closed on a repeated BOM prefix.
findings.root_cause: parse_template_document calls strip_prefix('\u{feff}') exactly ONCE, so a second BOM defeats opening_delimiter_len and split_frontmatter returns None, treating the whole document as body. Single-BOM control renders correctly as 'Hello World'.
findings.recommended_fix: Strip all leading BOMs (loop or trim_start_matches) instead of exactly one, or fail closed on a repeated BOM prefix.

---

    required: true
  a:
    required: false
---
BODY:{{a}}
findings.expected_oracle: Duplicate-key handling is the defect class cd54074 targeted. Duplicate keys are fail-closed at the var-file ingress (exit 3, ERR_CONFIG_PARSE) and in the `required_variables` list (exit 2, ERR_VAL_DUPLICATE); the frontmatter map sections must not silently diverge.
findings.observed_result: Exit 0, renders 'BODY:' -- the duplicate `a:` key silently collapses last-wins BEFORE the Rust duplicate-tracking code runs, so the `required: true` declaration is silently DISCARDED and no ERR_VAL_DUPLICATE or ERR_VAL_MISSING_REQUIRED fires. Same root cause for `defaults:` (dup key renders 'BODY:2' silently). Cause: RawFrontmatter's BTreeMap<String, _> fields inherit serde's permissive map deserialization rather than serde_yaml::Value's duplicate detection.
findings.requirement_trace: Not a regression -- reproduces pre-fix. But it means the duplicate-key defect CLASS is closed only at the var-file boundary, not at the frontmatter boundary. Silent loss of a `required: true` declaration is the most consequential instance.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Apply duplicate-key detection to frontmatter defaults:/input_defaults:/metadata:/variables: maps, matching the var-file boundary.
findings.root_cause: RawFrontmatter's BTreeMap<String, _> fields inherit serde's permissive map deserialization rather than serde_yaml::Value's duplicate detection.
findings.recommended_fix: Apply duplicate-key detection to frontmatter defaults:/input_defaults:/metadata:/variables: maps, matching the var-file boundary.

sections.summary: template-probe ran 106 bounded cases against the frontmatter subsystem with zero panics, timeouts, hangs, or confinement bypasses. One case (FUZZ-010, trailing CR/blank-line/whitespace normalization) was filed as inconclusive, not a confirmed bug: assemble_output()'s trim_end() is deliberate code, the render->verify round-trip is self-consistent, and no doc states whether the normalization is intended, so no defect could be established. No confirmed_bug is attributable to template-probe.
